title: Serverware Release Completion Proof v6
$comment: This schema closes only the trusted-host readiness completionProof/v6 structure. Final release authority is exclusively releaseCompletionVerification/v1 from the independent Manifest-v6 public Nitro verifier. This schema does not verify signatures, recompute digests, establish freshness, prove cross-document equality, or replace the native verifier.

nativeEvidenceValue.$comment: Nested provider evidence remains semantically authoritative only after native verification. Completion-proof canonicalization is integer-only, so every numeric value is a signed 64-bit integer.

productionEnvironmentBindingSummary.$comment: The readiness producer emits this closed top-level projection. Nested launcher trust is structural context only.

productionHostReadinessBoundary.$comment: This is trusted-host readiness context only. It neither proves secure time nor supplies authoritative TEE evidence to the independent final verifier.

productionHostPreflightSummary.$comment: The current producer has a closed top-level field inventory; nested platform and policy reports are versioned and semantically verified by native code.

proxyResponseSummary.$comment: The producer emits one of three native-verified contracts with an exact current top-level field set. Nested signed receipts remain bounded structural data; signatures, body equality, policy authority, and quote validity remain native-verifier semantics.

authorizationStatementV2.$comment: Structural acceptance is non-verifying and non-authorizing. JSON Schema does not enforce that expiresAtUnixSeconds is after issuedAtUnixSeconds by at most 30 seconds, or that request, authorization, and witness identity fields are equal. Native launch_authorization.py validation and signature verification are mandatory.

monotonicWitnessStatement.$comment: Structural acceptance is non-verifying and non-authorizing. JSON Schema does not enforce the maximum 30-second validity interval, predecessorStateSha256 != successorStateSha256, or equality with the embedded request and authorization statement. Native launch_authorization.py validation and witness verification are mandatory.

authorizationEnvelopeV2.$comment: The native verifier authenticates this Ed25519 envelope and binds its statement to the exact request digest. This schema only closes its representation.

launchAuthorizationV2.$comment: This closed projection does not authenticate signatures or prove cross-field or cross-document equality. Schema-only acceptance must never be treated as readiness verification or launch authority. Native launch_authorization.py verification is required.

bootstrapLauncherV3.$comment: This is the closed, verified summary of the sealed bootstrapReceipt/v3. The raw receipt has additional measured inputs that are revalidated by the native launcher and consumer before this summary is emitted.
